title: AskLocker for families
description: At 2:14 AM Papa is in hospital and nobody can find his health policy number. Then the same night with AskLocker: documents brought in, a paper policy scanned, the question asked aloud, and the answer read back.

chapters.title: 2:14 AM, and nobody can find the policy number

reviewNotes: Chapter times were measured from marketing/video's cue sheets (16:9 full cut, voice scene in English, 134.2 s) on 6 November 2026: those after the voice scene are 0.94 s earlier than the Hindi cut's. A changed film needs them measured again.
Rendered on 3 November 2026 with the end card's price corrected to ₹99 a month (PLUS_PRICE).

Checked on 3 November 2026: the statistic at 0:20 holds. ₹1.84 lakh crore is the Finance Minister's figure at the campaign's launch on 4 October 2025 (PTI; PIB release 2174806 itemises about ₹1.01 lakh crore of it), and the quote is word for word in PIB's 'Your Money, Your Right' release of 26 December 2025 (Ministry of Finance, https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2208730).
Published on 3 November 2026 at the owner's decision. The Gmail scene (0:33) shows a feature that, until Google verifies the Gmail scope, only listed test users can connect.

Replaced on 4 November 2026 with marketing/family/films/asklocker-family-16x9.mp4 (branch claude/admiring-curie-737iko): the owner asked for calmer sound, and that render has score.py's softer notification, chimes and beeps, so the 2:14 AM phone no longer rings with a buzz. The picture is the same frame for frame and the length the same, so the chapters and transcript hold.

Replaced on 6 November 2026 with the English cut, at the owner's ask, for viewers anywhere: node tools/render.mjs --lang en, then tools/mux.sh family-16x9-en, from marketing/video on claude/admiring-curie-737iko (f5cbcfa). Maa asks aloud in English and the app answers in English; the rest is the same frame for frame. Her two messages stay in Hinglish under English subtitles, as marketing/video's README keeps them in every language. The poster is the same moment, 2.3 s into the spoken answer (76.2 s).

Replaced on 8 November 2026 with the English cut made again from claude/films-english-maa (6ff5cba), at the owner's ask: the question-lock logo on the title and end cards (logoMark() from dev), and Maa's two messages in English too ("Son, we've brought Papa to hospital 🙏", "Found it, son 🙏 Cashless is approved. Go back to sleep ❤️"), the first subtitle in the same words. Same length, chapters, poster and loudness (TARGET_LUFS=-14.8); every other frame is the same.
